name: South Dakota

statute.cite: S.D. Codified Laws § 32-15-2.4 (windshield and front side)

windshield.strip: no film below the AS-1 line or below the lowest point of the sun visor; no sunscreening device that obstructs or reduces the clear view

frontSide.note: combined level (film + glass), enforcement tolerance 9 points

backSide.note: rear windows behind the operator's seat: 20%, enforcement tolerance 9 points

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ('reduces the light transmittance of such windows to the combined level'; definition includes 'the product or material and the glazing')

tolerance.cite: S.D. Codified Laws §§ 32-15-2.4, 32-15-2.5 ('enforcement tolerance of nine percent')

tint.certificateOrSticker: Officer must note the meter serial number and certification date on the citation (32-15-2.10)

medicalExemption.text: No medical exemption in ch. 32-15 as read (32-15-2.8 repealed in 2005)

penalty.text: Class 2 misdemeanor: up to 30 days in county jail and/or $500 fine

quotes: which reduces the light transmittance of such windows to the combined level below thirty-five percent, with an enforcement tolerance of nine percent
in the rear windows behind the operators seat that reduces light transmission below twenty percent, with an enforcement tolerance of nine percent
No film may be extended downward beyond the AS-1 line or more than the lowest point of the sun visor of the motor vehicle.
Class 2 misdemeanor: thirty days imprisonment in a county jail or five hundred dollars fine, or both.

helmet.conditions: Operators and riders under 18; operators may not carry an unhelmeted passenger under 18

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Separate restriction for permit/restricted-license holders (32-26-47.2, not read)
handheldPhone.fineText: Using a mobile electronic device (texting, manual entry) while driving: Class 2 misdemeanor (up to $500 / 30 days); calls and hands-free use excepted

studdedTires.season: Oct 1 - Apr 30 (prohibited May 1 - Sept 30; school buses and local fire vehicles over 5,000 lb excepted)

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

openQuestions: Primary enforcement of 32-26-47.1 assumed (no secondary clause in the text)
Underglow and lift rules not located
